title: Failed-Capture Retaliation
acceptance: Only the failing player is targeted. At most N pursuers (config), all within the join radius and the active habitat. Pursuers never leave the habitat footprint.
A catch knocks the player down for the configured time with no health loss. The player can move again afterwards, and the same pursuer can't chain-knockdown (cooldown).
Pursuit ends on timeout, distance, death, leaving or a swap. Pursuers return to roaming, and no state leaks (scenario).
Round 20 behaviour outside the approved trigger (startle hop, misses carried over) is unchanged. The ChaseRules and CaptureRules specs pass.
FullLoop, ExploitProbe and CrossPlot pass. `scripts/check.sh` passes.
